text: {"features":[{"name":"Academic preparation","description":"The strength of formal education presented relative to the role's preferred graduate-level background.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter presents a bachelor's degree in a relevant field as a basic credential and does not go beyond the posting's minimum education bar."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter presents a bachelor's degree in a relevant field as meaningful technical grounding, but still not as preferred graduate-level preparation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter presents a master's degree in a relevant technical field, matching the role's stated educational preference."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents a doctoral degree in a relevant technical field, signaling unusually deep formal preparation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents doctoral-level preparation as directly strengthening fit for the role's technical depth, not merely as a credential line."}]},{"name":"Professional track record","description":"The breadth of production software experience the letter establishes through testing, maintenance, launch, and ownership of real systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter shows only minimal qualifying experience, with limited production scope or ownership."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows early-career production experience that covers some testing, maintenance, or launches, but the breadth remains modest."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter establishes a solid multi-year record with multiple production services or launches and clear hands-on software experience."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents substantial production experience with repeated launch and maintenance responsibility across several services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows an extensive production record across many years and systems, with repeated evidence of operating, improving, and owning software in service of others."}]},{"name":"Go proficiency","description":"The depth with which the letter establishes Go as a role-relevant production language.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Go is only mentioned in passing, with no clear sense of depth, primacy, or production responsibility."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows practical Go use in production, but the depth or centrality of Go to the applicant's work remains vague."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter presents Go as a regular language for production services or backend tasks, showing clear working proficiency."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter makes Go the primary or daily language for backend or infrastructure work, indicating strong role fit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter ties Go to ownership of role-relevant backend systems that constrain, audit, or scale security automation, indicating deep fit."}]},{"name":"Python proficiency","description":"The extent to which the letter demonstrates substantive Python ability for production engineering work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not establish any meaningful Python experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions Python casually or mainly for lightweight scripting, with limited evidence of engineering depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows regular Python use for automation, analysis, or internal services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents Python as production-grade work used in services or tooling that other engineers depend on."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes Python central to robust automation or agent systems and presents it as mature engineering rather than ad hoc scripting."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"The degree to which the letter shows command of data structures and algorithms through concrete engineering use.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter provides no evidence of data structure or algorithmic strength."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter claims algorithmic ability in general terms, but gives little or no concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter gives one concrete example of using data structures or algorithms to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong algorithmic judgment through a clearly relevant example on a performance-critical or complexity-heavy problem."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter uses especially nuanced or multiple examples to show that algorithmic thinking materially shapes the applicant's system designs."}]},{"name":"Applied AI experience","description":"The strength of the letter's evidence that the applicant has built and shipped AI-enabled systems responsibly.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no meaningful evidence of AI experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter suggests AI familiarity or interest, but does not show shipped or concrete work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states direct experience building model-backed or LLM-based features in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter pairs shipped AI work with evaluation, guardrails, or reliability measures."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows mature production AI experience with explicit attention to trustworthiness, correctness, or hardening against unpredictable behavior."}]},{"name":"Agentic tooling design","description":"The degree to which the letter demonstrates design experience with autonomous or agent-based systems relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of agentic or autonomous tooling work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions agents or automation generically, but offers no architecture or control model."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes a system in which agents perform useful tasks, showing basic agentic design exposure."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter explains concrete controls such as permissions, boundaries, supervision, or auditability around agent behavior."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents agentic tooling as a deliberately engineered security-relevant system, showing how bounded autonomy scales expert work."}]},{"name":"Security assessment practice","description":"The strength of evidence that the applicant has performed real security review work on software systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter provides no evidence of security review or assessment work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions security reviews or assessments in broad terms, but shows little method or depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes recognizable assessment work such as threat modeling, code review, or attack-surface analysis."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows structured assessment practice that includes validation of fixes or attacker-style reasoning."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter frames assessments as systematic engineering work across designs and implementations, with clear methodology and remediation follow-through."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"The degree to which the letter shows hands-on experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, or response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no direct evidence of work on vulnerability reports, triage, or response automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter speaks about reducing manual security toil, but does not show hands-on implementation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states that the applicant automated intake or triage of vulnerability reports."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter explains concrete triage functions such as classification, routing, deduplication, or self-serve handling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong ownership of vulnerability-response automation and its operational effect on workload, attention, or response quality."}]},{"name":"Role insight","description":"How well the letter demonstrates understanding of this specific job's responsibilities, constraints, and technical mix.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter sounds generic to security or backend engineering and rarely references the actual responsibilities of this job."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions one or two posted themes, such as automation or secure defaults, but only loosely maps experience to them."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter addresses several responsibilities or preferred qualifications in a recognizably targeted way."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly connects past work to this team's mix of vulnerability handling, developer support, and Go plus Python security tooling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows precise understanding of the mandate, including scaling expert judgment through automation or agents, and makes the fit feel highly intentional."}]},{"name":"Security enablement philosophy","description":"The clarity and sophistication of the applicant's view of security as developer-enabling engineering.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter says little about how security should function inside a software organization."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter expresses generic interest in security impact without a clear point of view on enablement."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states that security should reduce toil or help developers rather than only police them."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter articulates a clear philosophy around secure defaults, platform leverage, or building tools that teams will actually adopt."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents a nuanced developer-enabling philosophy in which trustworthy automation multiplies scarce security expertise while minimizing friction."}]},{"name":"Production rigor","description":"The degree to which the letter shows a reliability-minded, maintainable, failure-aware approach to building software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no concrete signal of reliability, maintainability, or failure-oriented thinking."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter makes generic claims about care, rigor, or correctness, but offers little supporting detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows some production discipline, such as maintaining inherited systems, building tested tooling, or operating services responsibly."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter gives clear evidence of building for reliability through boundaries, auditability, failover, maintainability, or explicit concern for future operators."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter consistently frames engineering choices around failure modes, long-term maintenance, and trustworthy system behavior, making production rigor a defining theme."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"The extent to which the letter supports its claims with concrete examples, mechanisms, scope, or outcomes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter relies mostly on broad claims or adjectives with few concrete details."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter includes some specifics, but many important claims remain unsupported or vague."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter backs several claims with concrete examples, projects, or responsibilities."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter regularly gives enough context to understand the mechanism, scope, or impact of the work described."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter consistently supports its claims with concrete examples that reveal how the work was done and what changed because of it."}]},{"name":"Independent security credibility","description":"The strength of external or extracurricular signals that the applicant has developed security skill beyond ordinary job claims.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter offers no credential, competition, or outside-practice signal of security ability."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter provides only a basic external signal, such as an entry-level certification or a casual hobby reference."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows sustained extra security effort through a baseline credential plus practice or through recurring hands-on exercises."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter provides a strong external signal, such as OSCP-level certification or clearly competitive capture-the-flag performance."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter combines multiple strong external signals or presents one with exceptional hands-on rigor and demonstrated performance."}]},{"name":"Open source engagement","description":"The extent to which the letter shows contribution to or stewardship of shared software used beyond the applicant's immediate job.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of contributing to software outside the day job."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions occasional fixes or vague upstream activity without much ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes regular patching or contribution to open-source tools used at work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows repeated upstream responsibility or maintenance activity with visible stewardship."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents clear maintainership of an actively used project, including review, release, or community ownership."}]},{"name":"Project ambition","description":"The technical difficulty and self-directed nature of personal engineering work described outside the applicant's main employment.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter offers no self-directed project evidence or only a very small utility with no meaningful technical stretch."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions a modest side project with limited complexity or challenge."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows a self-directed project that goes beyond tutorials and demonstrates real implementation effort."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes a technically challenging system or infrastructure project chosen to tackle hard problems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter highlights an ambitious systems project that confronts difficult guarantees such as consistency, failover, exactly-once delivery, or crash recovery."}]},{"name":"Narrative cohesion","description":"How clearly the letter builds a coherent case from motivation through evidence to fit.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter reads like disconnected statements or fragments rather than a purposeful application."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter has a basic sequence, but weak transitions or abrupt shifts keep the case from building effectively."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter is generally coherent and easy to follow from opening to closing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter builds a clear throughline from motivation to evidence to fit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter creates a memorable narrative arc that makes the applicant's background and interest feel cumulative and intentional."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"The level of polish in spelling, grammar, usage, and other surface-level writing execution.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter contains pervasive spelling, grammar, or formatting errors that noticeably distract from the content."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter contains frequent errors that repeatedly interrupt polish or professionalism."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter has several noticeable errors, but the meaning stays clear."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter is mostly clean, with only minor slips that do not impede the reading experience."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is polished, professional, and essentially error-free."}]}]}
